basic_info.description: 1968 Post Street is a well-maintained six (6) unit apartment building located at the corner of Post and Steiner Streets in San Francisco's Lower Pacific Heights. The 8,271 square foot property features four (4) five-room and two (2) six-room flats, all configured as 3-bedroom, 1-bath units. The building generates over $264,000 in annual gross income, is separately metered for gas and electricity, and includes in-unit laundry in five of the six units. It has been professionally managed and consistently maintained.  Tenants enjoy excellent access to neighborhood amenities and major transit lines, including the 38 Geary and 22 Fillmore. The property is within walking distance of Upper and Lower Fillmore, Japantown, and UCSF Medical Center.  With its prime corner location, classic architecture, and strong in-place income, 1968 Post Street presents a rare opportunity to acquire a quality asset in one of San Francisco's most convenient and desirable rental markets.
